info.description: Tag registry for the mail client. The slug is the IMAP custom keyword (rt_*) actually stored on messages — tags live on the mail server, survive without import, and appear in other IMAP clients. Manager-maintained; everyone reads.

slug.description: IMAP keyword atom, generated from the name on create (rt_<slug>). Immutable — renaming a tag keeps the keyword so existing messages stay tagged.
